title: Emanation Level
overview: The mysteries behind Lord Heydrich's plan, and the highest, most hidden level of magic, are revealed.

title: Gladsheim
overview: The secrets behind the Grail's birth and its powers are revealed, as the protagonist's plan falls apart in the face of the enemy's overwhelming power.

title: Golden Alchemy
overview: Heydrich begins his holy war, and puts his plan to turn the world into Valhalla into action.

title: Valhalla Emanation
overview: Shiro and Sakurai battle the surviving lieutenants of the Black Round Table, while Heydrich leaves to prepare for a final encounter.

title: Verweile Doch
overview: The last battle against Reinhard and the Black Round Table heads for its final conclusion, with the fate of the world in the balance.

title: To the New World
overview: A new world is about to begin as the four masters of the Atziluth gather on the golden shore to decide whose law shall reign.
